svg.title: Particle swarm update
svg.desc: Actual update of particle 8 at iteration 3 with seed 11. The gray arrow is the inertia term. Dashed arrows indicate attraction toward personal and global best positions. The teal arrow includes the movement bounds. Coordinates are controller gains, not physical drone positions.
svg.text: Each point is a pair of drone controller gains.
Update position using inertia, personal best, and global best.
Repeat position updates and objective evaluations across the swarm.
